quest.2000000000000020.title: &dCity Hunter
quest.2000000000000020.quest_desc: &7Beyond the central island and across the void lie the &dEnd Cities&7 — purple towers built by long-vanished beings.
&eHow to find one:&7 take an Ender Pearl or boat across the void after killing the Ender Dragon, or use a &6Map of the End&7.
&eInside you will find:&7 Shulkers, diamond gear, enchanted books, and the prized &fElytra&7 aboard an End Ship.
&aBring projectiles — Shulkers float and hit hard.
quest.2000000000000022.title: &fSky's the Limit
quest.2000000000000022.quest_subtitle: &7Claim the Elytra and rule the air.&r
quest.2000000000000022.quest_desc: &7The &fElytra&7 is found on the End Ship, in an item frame above the boat.
Equip it in the chestplate slot, then jump from a height and hold &eSpace&7 to glide.
&eBoost with Firework Rockets&7 for forward thrust. Combine with &6Unbreaking III&7 and &dMending&7 for longevity.
&aTrue endgame mobility — no fall damage, infinite vistas.
quest.2000000000000030.title: &dAlien Food
quest.2000000000000030.quest_desc: &7&dChorus Fruit&7 grows on the outer End islands atop tall purple stalks.
Break the &etop blocks first&7 — the plant collapses, dropping every chorus fruit it carried.
&eEat it&7 to teleport a few blocks at random — handy escape tool.
&eCook it&7 into &6Popped Chorus Fruit&7 to craft &dPurpur Blocks&7 and &fEnd Rods&7.
